sloka: हा वीर रिपुदर्पघ्न कुम्भकर्ण महाबल।त्वं मां विहाय वै दैवाद्यातो ऽसि यमसादनम् ।। ६.६८.१० ।।
transliteration: hā vīra ripudarpaghna kumbhakarṇa mahābala।tvaṁ māṁ vihāya vai daivādyāto 'si yamasādanam ।। 6.68.10 ।।

translations.english: "Ha! Hero! Kumbhakarna! You, who crushed the pride of the enemy, endowed with great prowess have deserted me and gone to the abode of death, actually by divine will."
